title.zh: 提升有限嵌套共同方案

statement.en: Where configurations a description identifies match parts into ones it identifies and leaves are read correctly through it, a plan is realized at a description exactly where it is at each configuration so described; plans with descriptions as leaves lift through it exactly where it matches parts.
statement.zh: 凡一个描述所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形、叶经它被正确读出，一个计划在一个描述处被实现，恰当它在如此被描述的每个构形处被实现；叶为描述的计划经该描述提升，恰在它匹配部分处。

laws.en: A joint plan is a finite binary nesting of leaves; a configuration realizes it where it holds together parts realizing its two sides, down to leaves read at the parts, each node with its own witness. Read through a description, the joint relation holds among descriptions where some configuration so described holds together parts so described.
laws.zh: 共同计划是叶的有限二叉嵌套；一个构形实现它，是指它共同持有实现其两侧的部分，直到在部分处读出的叶，每个节点各有其见证。经描述读出，共同关系在描述之间成立，是指某个如此被描述的构形共同持有如此被描述的部分。

laws.en: A relation B matches the parts two joint relations hold together where, wherever B relates two configurations, each pair of parts the first holds together under the first relation is matched by a pair the second holds together under the second, related by B part by part.
laws.zh: 关系 B 匹配两个共同关系所持的部分，是指凡 B 关联两个构形处，前者在第一个关系下共同持有的每对部分，都被后者在第二个关系下共同持有的一对所匹配，逐部分由 B 关联。

laws.en: For any ternary joint relation and any description: where configurations the description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies, and the leaves are read correctly through it, every plan is realized at the description of a configuration, under the joint relation read through the description, exactly where it is realized at that configuration.
laws.zh: 对任意三元共同关系与任意描述：凡该描述所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形、叶经它被正确读出，每个计划在一个构形的描述处（经该描述读出的共同关系之下）被实现，恰当它在该构形处被实现。

laws.en: Take plans whose leaves are descriptions, a leaf read at a configuration where it is the configuration's description: each is realized at the description of each configuration exactly where it is realized there, exactly where configurations the description identifies match parts into ones it identifies; the direction from description to configuration alone gives matching parts.
laws.zh: 取叶为描述的计划（叶在一个构形处读出，是指它是该构形的描述）：每个计划在每个构形的描述处被实现恰当它在该构形处被实现，恰当该描述所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形；只由描述到构形一个方向即给出部分匹配。

laws.en: In a joint frame, through a code that reads the joint tests exactly and gives configurations passing the same joint tests one code: where the pairs of parts each configuration holds together are compact for the joint tests, every joint test holds wherever it cannot fail, and the leaves are read correctly through the code, every plan is realized at the code of a configuration exactly where it is realized there.
laws.zh: 在共同框架中，经一个精确读出共同检验、并给通过相同共同检验之构形同一编码的编码：凡每个构形共同持有的部分之对对共同检验紧致、每个共同检验在不能不成立处成立、叶经编码被正确读出，每个计划在一个构形的编码处被实现，恰当它在该构形处被实现。

hypotheses.en: Description form: any ternary joint relation on configurations of any kind and any description; MatchesParts through the description and pointwise leaf correctness.
hypotheses.zh: 描述形式：任意类型构形上的任意三元共同关系与任意描述；经描述的 MatchesParts 与逐叶的正确读出。

hypotheses.en: Code form: a joint frame of the spine and a code of its joint tests, with JointCompact, TestsStable, Exact, Reduced and pointwise leaf correctness.
hypotheses.zh: 编码形式：脊柱的共同框架与其共同检验的编码，带 JointCompact、TestsStable、Exact、Reduced 与逐叶的正确读出。

does_not_show.en: The code form takes the tests' stability as a hypothesis: excluded middle gives it, and without it, matching parts by the joint tests in every joint frame of one move and one claim with compact pairs of parts is exactly excluded middle.
does_not_show.zh: 编码形式以检验稳定为假设：排中律给出它；没有它时，在每个只有一种动作与一种主张、部分之对紧致的共同框架中以共同检验匹配部分，恰是排中律。

does_not_show.en: Existence of a witnessed plan does not make arbitrary designated parts composable.
does_not_show.zh: 不能把某个计划有见证升级为任意指定部分均能接合。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker: the current bytes of Becoming.Composition, Becoming.JointCorrespondence and Becoming.JointPlans are bound to core receipts under becoming-checks, and those of Becoming.Likeness to core receipt 20261027T195912.152773Z; every cited core declaration has an empty axiom report. The periphery ExplanatoryJointness and the retired CompositionBridge are provenance; their receipt under explanatory-jointness-checks keeps its earlier scope.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查：Composition、JointCorrespondence 与 JointPlans 的当前字节绑定 becoming-checks 下的核心回执，Likeness 绑定核心回执 20261027T195912.152773Z；所引核心声明的公理报告均为空。外围的 ExplanatoryJointness 与退役的 CompositionBridge 是来源；explanatory-jointness-checks 下的回执保持原范围。

next_delta.en: Supply an application's description and leaf reading and lift its finite nested plans through the description form, or, for a code of the joint tests, through the code form with the stability of the tests stated.
next_delta.zh: 给出应用中的描述与叶的读法，经描述形式提升其有限嵌套计划；对共同检验的编码，则经编码形式，并写明检验稳定。

correspondence.zh: 每节点共享一个共同见证；叶项身份与跨分支共享不由代码存在自动确定。
correspondence.en: Each node retains a common witness; leaf identities and cross-branch sharing are not automatically fixed by code existence.

detail.zh: 逐节点调用整体共同分解提升，再对子方案归纳。
detail.en: Each node invokes whole-decomposition lifting, followed by induction on subplans.

output.zh: 给定整体代表的成对原生见证。
output.en: Native paired witnesses for a given whole representative.

input.zh: 递归方案节点的子整体和编码等式。
input.en: Subwholes and code equalities for the recursive plan node.

conditions.zh: 相同模型、紧致性、准确约简表示及叶项解释。
conditions.en: Same model, compactness, exact reduced presentation and leaf interpretation.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述，附加一个假设。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。若描述所认同的配置把部分匹配到其所认同的配置且叶的读法正确，则描述实现一嵌套计划，恰当其所描述的每一配置实现之（JointPlan.realizes_image_iff）；计划自每一配置提升即部分匹配（JointPlan.plans_lift_iff）。所以在模型检验稳定处 joint_plan_lifts 在脊柱上成立（joint_plan_lifts_of_stable）；排中律给出稳定，无稳定时经典步骤恰是排中律。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。每一节点各有见证；外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with one added hypothesis. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. Where configurations a description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies and the leaves are read correctly, a description realizes a nested plan exactly where every configuration it describes does (JointPlan.realizes_image_iff), and plans lifting from every configuration is matching parts (JointPlan.plans_lift_iff). So joint_plan_lifts holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (joint_plan_lifts_of_stable); excluded middle gives stability, and without it the classical step is exactly excluded middle. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). Each node keeps its own witness; the periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
